rationale: Fixes PopupWindow closing as focus_lost when activating the application hands key back to the popup's own editor window with no click. The resign-key decision now waits one run-loop pass and takes key back in that case, so only a real move of key elsewhere reports focus_lost. A behaviour fix in the generic platform layer with no view or render dependency, so the next Vellum re-export of core/platform should carry it.
